All 58 tests pass.

I wrote `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/reflect/FieldUtilsAgentTest.java` with 58 self-contained test methods covering `FieldUtils`, including boundary cases (null/blank arguments, nonexistent fields, non-static fields passed to static-only methods), scope/accessibility rules (`forceAccess` true/false for private/protected/package fields), inheritance lookups, ambiguous interface field resolution, annotation-based field lookup, final-field removal/writing semantics (including the static-final-field exception even with `forceAccess`), and the deprecated no-arg constructor.

All 58 tests pass — I found no behavior in `FieldUtils` that contradicts its documented contract, so there are no bug-revealing failing tests to report.
